name: Camera-follow captions
description: Each sentence written across a canvas far bigger than the frame while a camera follows the words as they are said: every word a step bigger than the last with the camera pulling back to keep it the same size (or the camera gliding along lines of text), motion blur on every move, and a pull-back at the sentence's end to show it whole. Give a transcript with --words; *starred* words and the ones in `accents` take the accent.

text.label: Text
text.description: what is said; leave empty to caption the transcript as it is. Wrap a word in *stars* for the accent
text.default: Captions that follow every word you say, *right* on time.

accents.label: Accent words
accents.description: words to put in the accent wherever they are said, comma separated

camera.label: Camera
camera.description: grow: each word a step bigger, the camera pulling back to keep up · track: lines of one size, the camera gliding along them

framing.label: Framing
framing.description: how big the newest word is on screen

growth.label: Growth
growth.description: grow camera: how much bigger each word is than the last

ending.label: Sentence end
ending.description: pull back: the camera shows each sentence whole once it is said · hold: it stays on the last word

ground.label: Behind the words
ground.description: vignette: a soft dark edge over the footage · none: straight on the footage with a shadow · panel: the brand's ground, full frame

parts.ground: the vignette or panel behind the words
parts.words: the words and the camera over them
